catalog.method: FILE_ONLY: no live catalog is integrated, by the owner's decision (2026-11-26). The live catalog exists but stays out of this integration; only files (.nad) and texts (nad://) are supported.
catalog.notes: The live catalog endpoint is deliberately NOT wired: no catalog URL, no credentials and no session/token in this integration.

files.method: A .nad file is text with a NADIA_SEC_V2: / NADIA_SEC_PW2: / NADIA_SEC_HWID: / NADIA_SEC_HWID_PW: prefix + Base64 of the sec2 envelope (salt||iv||HMAC||ciphertext, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 + AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256), or the raw binary envelope. Clear content is a java.util.Properties XML document. Texts are nad://sec2: / nad://pw2: / nad:// (JSON).
